records.words: I remember insist working and visits giving me a guess after a long walk. This edition says I can give a spoken answer. I want to try a visit and see whether I can actually answer this time.
The phone has a small map and a row of houses running past the edge, but I can read the reply count. There is an actual 07:30 clock now. I will wait for the first delays before choosing a visit.
Zehra is the first delay again. I remember learning too late that she was pregnant. I will visit her instead of pressing her this time.

This note is late, after the wait returned at 72 seconds. I called the hamlet and chose a visit to Zehra instead of insisting as I did before. The clock says 08:00 and twenty game minutes until arrival, unchanged after fifteen real seconds. The phone reply text is readable. I want the spoken answer, not another test of insist.
The reading view said return to the notebook. I will do that rather than stare at an unchanged arrival estimate.
There is something to say this time. I came to listen is exactly the alternative to pressing I wanted to test.
My sentence is recorded, but nobody has answered it yet. I will leave the notebook open and wait for her reply.
Come in arrived after I already said I came to listen. I cannot tell whether that is an answer to me or just the visit greeting. I will look at the house record.
They have almost no food left, labelled as my guess. Listening has not changed Zehra’s delay. I want to see whether grain is a concrete offer I can weigh against the due.
That sent it immediately. I expected the explanation I got last time, not a committed gift. I have spent grain without knowing how much. Checking the ledger now.

Twenty-four in the granary now. My earlier diary had thirty at the start, so I think I gave six, but I did not check this world before sending. The total is about 385 against 384 again. I will wait to see whether the household answers the gift or my visit.

I could speak, but the visit still feels like waiting beside an unchanged greeting. The clock and time-until-home now tell me what I am waiting for. I want to see the visit finish before deciding whether listening did anything.

The grain got a proper answer: thank the landowner or thank God. That feels directed at what I did. Zehra still delays, which is fair; I did not buy her work. I want to check whether my listening sentence left a record before I go.

I would stop here. I got to say I came to listen, but I have not seen an answer to that sentence or a record distinct from sitting. Giving grain produced a better reply, though I sent it without knowing the amount. I am still waiting through the same morning, and I do not want another visit just to repeat this experiment.

I stopped playing at 247.798 seconds. The wish did not pass. I would not return voluntarily now or another evening to repeat this visit. I would reconsider if I could see what my spoken answer changed, beyond having sat with them. The clock is clearer now, but I still do not want to wait through the harvest. I would not leave it running. I selected I'm stopping locally; it filled those words into the box. I typed nothing, changed no consent and submitted nothing. The browser is no longer needed.
